activity.notes: Ouray became a leader of the Tabeguache/Uncompahgre Utes around 1860 and remained a leading negotiator until his death in 1880. The US government's later designation of him as head chief of the Utes did not establish hereditary sovereignty over every Ute band; the Activity is attached to his own Uncompahgre community.
